parameter_descriptions.beta: Transition distance scale parameter (meters) in Newson-Krumm exponential model: exp(-|d_net - d_gps| / beta).
parameter_descriptions.emission_weight: Weight multiplier for the ML classifier log posterior probability in the emission calculation.
parameter_descriptions.transition_weight: Weight multiplier for the network routing transition log probability.
parameter_descriptions.sigma_z: Standard deviation of GPS spatial measurement noise in meters.
parameter_descriptions.max_dist_cutoff_factor: Multiplier applied to GPS step displacement to bound Dijkstra search radius.
parameter_descriptions.min_cutoff_m: Absolute minimum distance cutoff for single-source Dijkstra search in meters.
parameter_descriptions.disconnect_penalty: Log-probability penalty applied when no directed graph path connects two candidate segments.
